Phoenix Wellness & Recovery helps everyday people, working professionals, and athletes move better, recover effectively, and feel their best.

Located in Kendall, Miami, we offer manual therapy, massage therapy, functional stretching, mobility work, exercise recovery, and personalized wellness services.

Subscribe for recovery education, mobility tips, service demonstrations, client stories, and practical ways to improve how your body feels and performs.

Book your visit: www.phxrecover.com
